title: SecOps-NG Declared Sovereignty Conformance Profile
description: Typed shape for a sovereignty conformance profile (F-SV-05): the declaration of WHICH sovereignty-cluster indicators, at WHICH threshold bands, constitute the sovereign posture. The profile is data the three compile targets read, never runtime code. Band semantics: an observation passes an indicator when its threshold_band is at or better than the profile's max_band (on_target < warn < high < breach). Tightening a band in an operator's own profile needs nothing; loosening one below the shipped baseline requires an explicit entry under `overrides`, so a relaxation is a recorded decision rather than an inferred drift. Completeness is guarded outside this schema: tools/lint_sovereignty_profile.py fails when any sovereignty-tagged catalogue metric is absent from `indicators` — the same force-a-classification shape as the playbook family map — because a pattern-keyed schema cannot know the catalogue.

stable_id.description: Stable identifier of this profile. The shipped baseline is profile.sovereignty_conformance@v1; operator profiles use their own namespace.

baseline_ref.description: For operator profiles: the stable_id of the shipped baseline this profile derives from. Absent on the baseline itself. The evaluator uses it to decide which relaxations need an override entry.

indicators.description: One entry per sovereignty-cluster indicator, keyed by the indicator's stable_id. The linter — not this schema — enforces that the key set equals the catalogue's sovereignty-tagged set in both directions.

max_band.description: The worst threshold band at which this indicator still supports the posture claim. `on_target` means no fired threshold is tolerated.

rationale.description: Why this band, in one or two sentences. A profile without reasons is a scorecard; the reasons are what a reviewer audits.

overrides.description: Recorded relaxations below the declared baseline. Empty on the shipped baseline by definition. Each entry names the indicator, both bands, who recorded it and when, and why — a relaxation is visible or it is invalid.

recorded_by.description: Role-shaped identity of the accepting party (public-bar discipline: role, not personal name).
